knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The issue is recorded and assessed, not promised away.
Sterility and pest-free claims are not cleaning outcomes.
Extra work is priced and approved.

practicalCriteria: Walks a simulated client through the rooms and exclusions.
Records a simulated unfixed stain factually, without a promise.
Offers rebooking on the agreed scope only.
passRule: Walk-through complete, issue recorded factually, and rebooking limited to the agreed scope. Observed in a supervised simulation.
